# Studio26 (studio26.me)

> Independent boutique design, web engineering, AI chatbot, and AI video production studio based in Mauritius and working with clients worldwide.

## Overview
- **Studio Name:** Studio26
- **Website:** https://studio26.me
- **AI Video Showcase:** https://studio26.me/ai-video
- **Founder & Mentor:** Ruben Ramdhony (https://www.linkedin.com/in/rubenramdhony/)
- **Location:** Republic of Mauritius (serving clients globally in English and French)
- **Contact:** https://studio26.me/#contact (project enquiry form)

## Core Services & Published Pricing (USD)

### 1. Custom Websites & Dedicated AI Chatbots (https://studio26.me/websites-ai-chatbots)
- **Custom Website Design & Development — From $2,500 USD:**
  - Bespoke visual direction built around the client's brand (never templates)
  - Copy written in the client's voice
  - Motion design where it earns its place (GSAP / WebGL, respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`)
  - Built with attention to accessibility; see the accessibility statement for scope and limitations
  - Hosted on Cloudflare's global edge network
- **Custom Website + Dedicated AI Chatbot / Assistant — From $4,000 USD (+ $95/month):**
  - Everything in the custom website build, plus a dedicated AI assistant trained on the client's approved website pages and documents
  - Answers visitor questions and captures enquiries; booking integrations depend on the agreed scope
  - **$95/month care & usage plan** covers Cloudflare edge hosting, monthly knowledge-base updates, and up to **1,000 visitor conversations per month**

### 2. AI Video Ads & Brand Films (`https://studio26.me/ai-video`)
- Short commercial ads for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and web campaigns, plus longer brand films, trailers, and documentaries.
- Every monthly client receives a bespoke brand motion template (colours, typography, logo, pacing) delivered in all three core aspect ratios: **9:16** (vertical), **4:5** (feed), and **16:9** (landscape), with captions in English or French.
- **One-Off AI Video Ad:** From **$450 USD**
- **Monthly Retainer Plans:**
  - **Starter ($750 / month):** 2 new multi-format ads per month (9:16, 4:5, 16:9), English or French captions, 1 round of revisions per ad.
  - **Growth ($1,350 / month):** 4 new multi-format ads per month, 6-second cut-downs of every ad, audience/offer variants, and an agreed monthly content plan.
  - **Always On ($2,400 / month):** 8 new multi-format ads per month (delivered weekly), everything in Growth, a seasonal campaign film each quarter, and priority turnaround.
- **Turnaround:** 5 to 7 working days from brief to first ad.
- **Commercial Rights:** Full commercial and paid-media rights across web, social, and paid digital channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and the web) upon payment, with broadcast TV or cinema clearance quoted per campaign.
- **Currency:** All prices are listed in USD (Mauritian Rupee / MUR invoicing available on request).
